title: Zesty Crumbly Saudi Arabian Lamb Kebabs
description: A solo dinner dish featuring lamb, rice paper sheets, and a blend of Saudi Arabian spices, perfect for a weeknight meal. This satvik-friendly dish is easy to make and packed with flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, cumin, coriander, and paprika.
Add the lamb pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated lamb pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 15 minutes.
While the lamb is cooking, prepare the rice paper sheets by cutting them into smaller pieces.
After the lamb has cooked for 15 minutes, brush the rice paper pieces with a little water and wrap each piece around a lamb skewer.
Return the skewers to the oven and bake for an additional 5 minutes, or until the rice paper is crispy and golden brown.
Remove the skewers from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes before serving.
To serve, place a skewer on each plate and garnish with fresh parsley or cilantro.
